source_notes: Prospective C4 60M/L2048 extension after research/table2-joint-results-v1-20261104.
100M token cap, micro-batch4, global batch64, seeds6198/1024/7; non-tuned settings match the completed reference.
Sigma sweep1/5/10/25/50/100/200/500/2000 at one/two HIPE layers; sigma50 completes H1-H8 coverage with reused controls.
Eight total decoder layers; final H layers use HIPE, initial layers use RoPE. H8 uses the supported uniform schedule.
RoPE is the actual H0 control. Sigma0 is not a RoPE alias.
All complete existing fixed-configuration seed sets are reused; 20 new configurations x3 seeds =60full runs.
One GPU per SLURM task, max2 concurrent, no DDP. Report every candidate; mean/SD never pool sigma or layer counts.
XPos comparisons remain local; public Table2 outputs use its original method set.
